items.passageLabel: Passage 3: Information theory - the big idea

items.example: Ex: The countryside around here is stunningly beautiful.

sections.title: Passage 1: Attitudes to language
sections.html:
understandable

(adjective). Có thể hiểu được; dễ hiểu

Ex: Although I don't approve of his actions, I think they are understandable.

argument

(noun). lý lẽ, lý luận

Ex: Having heard both sides of the argument, the court will make a decision.

systematic

(adjective). Có hệ thống

Ex: None of the studies were sufficiently systematic to give a reliable result.

objective

(adjective). khách quan

Ex: I can't really be objective when I'm judging my daughter's work.

right

(noun). Quyền

Ex: Everyone should have the right to freedom of expression.

occur

(verb). xảy ra

Ex: Three major events occurred in my life that year.

emotion

(noun). cảm xúc

Ex: The decision was based on emotion rather than rational thought.

differ

(verb). khác, không giống

Ex: French differs from English in this respect.

usage

(noun). Cách sử dụng từ trong một ngôn ngữ

Ex: Dictionaries show typical patterns of usage.

minor

(adjective). Nhỏ lẻ, không quan trọng

Ex: There may be some minor changes to the schedule.

major

(adjective). chủ yếu, quan trọng

Ex: He played a major role in setting up the system.

policy

(noun). chính sách

Ex: The company has adopted a firm policy on shoplifting.

linguistic

(adjective). liên quan đến ngôn ngữ

Ex: I'm particularly interested in the linguistic development of young children.

assessment

(noun). sự đánh giá; sự ước định

Ex: The city hired them to do a structural assessment of the damage.

affect

(verb). ảnh hưởng

Ex: Your opinion will not affect my decision.

factor

(noun). Nhân tố

Ex: The result will depend on a number of different factors.

judge

(verb). đánh giá

Ex: You shouldn't judge her too harshly.

status

(noun). Tình trạng

Ex: What is the current status of our application for funds?

influence

(verb). ảnh hưởng

Ex: His film is heavily influenced by other film-makers.

prescriptive

(adjective). đề ra quy tắc, đưa ra cách dùng

Ex: For while there are detailed teacher's notes provided, the Student's Books themselves are not at all prescriptive.

approach

(noun). cách tiếp cận, phương pháp

Ex: The approach they were using no longer seemed to work.

attitude

(noun). Thái độ

Ex: If you want to pass your exams you'd better change your attitude!

motivate

(verb). Khuyến khích, tạo động lực

Ex: What motivates people to carry out such attacks?

widespread

(adjective). phổ biến rộng rãi

Ex: The storm caused widespread damage.

concern

(noun). mối lo ngại, mối quan tâm

Ex: Villagers expressed concern about the level of traffic.

exist

(verb). Tồn tại

Ex: I don't think ghosts exist.

maintain

(verb). duy trì, khăng khăng

Ex: The men maintained that they were out of the country when the crime was committed.

attempt

(noun). lần thử, nỗ lực

Ex: Ex: Attempts are being made to resolve the problem of security in schools.

evaluate

(verb). Đánh giá

Ex: It's impossible to evaluate these results without knowing more about the research methods employed.

diversity

(noun). sự đa dạng

Ex: There is a need for greater diversity and choice in education.

pointless

(adjective). vô nghĩa

Ex: We searched until we knew it would be pointless to continue.

prescribe

(verb). quy định

Ex: What punishment does the law prescribe for this crime?

halt

(verb). Ngăn cản

Ex: We are failing to halt the destruction of the rainforest.

summarise

(verb). Tóm tắt, tổng kết

Ex: The results of the research are summarized at the end of the chapter.

statement

(noun). sự phát biểu, phát ngôn

Ex: He made a rather misleading statement.

variation

(noun). biến thể

Ex: Further analysis revealed significant regional variations in the results.

appear

(verb). xuất hiện

Ex: Symptoms usually start appearing within two to three days.

advocate

(verb). ủng hộ

Ex: he group does not advocate the use of violence.

extreme

(adjective). vô cùng, cực độ

Ex: We are working under extreme pressure at the moment.

misrepresent

(verb). trình bày sai

Ex: He felt that the book misrepresented his opinions.

opposition

(noun). sự chống đối

Ex: He spent five years in prison for his opposition to the regime.

inherently

(adverb). vốn có, vốn đã

Ex: She felt that the system was inherently unfair and unequal.

impose

(verb). áp đặt

Ex: The government has imposed a ban on the sale of handguns.

variety

(noun). Sự đa dạng

Ex: In order to be healthy, a child needs to eat a variety of food.

characterize

(verb). Biểu thị đặc điểm, mô tả đặc điểm

Ex: How would you characterize the mood of the 1990s?

nature

(noun). bản chất

Ex: His work explores the nature of the mother-child relationship.

reliance

(noun). Dependence on or trust in someone or something.

Ex: The region's reliance on tourism is unwise.

linguist

(noun). nhà ngôn ngữ học

Ex: She's an excellent linguist.

authoritarian

(adjective). Độc đoán

Ex: Many have accused him of an authoritarian style of leadership.

conversely

(adverb). Ngược lại mà nói

Ex: You can add the fluid to the powder, or, conversely, the powder to the fluid.

custom

(noun). thói quen

Ex: It’s my custom to go for a walk on Saturday mornings

base on

(verb). dựa vào

Ex: What are you basing this theory on?

original

(adjective). Nguyên bản, khởi nguồn

Ex: The room still has many of its original features.

discredit

(verb). bác bỏ

Ex: These theories are now largely discredited among linguists.

present

(verb). đưa ra, bày ra

Ex: Are you presenting a paper at the conference?

account

(noun). Lời tường thuật

Ex: The diaries contained a detailed account of the writer's experiences in China.

certain

(adjective). nhất định, nào đó

Ex: You can choose to only watch certain kinds of movies.

invective

(noun). lời chửi rủa

Ex: The gesture infuriated him and he let out a stream of invective.

polemic

(noun). tranh cãi gay gắt

Ex: She has published a fierce anti-war polemic.

debate

(verb). tranh luận

Ex: Politicians will be debating the bill later this week.

deteriorate

(verb). trở nên xấu hơn

Ex: They had to cope with deteriorating weather conditions.

exempt

(adjective). miễn

Ex: Some students are exempt from certain exams.

reference

(noun). sự nói đến, sự nhắc đến

Ex: She made no reference to her illness but only to her future plans.

favour

(verb). ủng hộ, thích dùng hơn

Ex: These are the running shoes favoured by marathon runners.

reflect

(verb). phản ánh, cho thấy bản chất của

Ex: Our newspaper aims to reflect the views of the local community.

encounter

(verb). chạm trán, gặp gỡ

Ex: We encountered a number of difficulties in the first week.

adherent

(noun). người ủng hộ

Ex: The anti-globalization movement is attracting new adherents to its principles.

apparent

(adjective). Rõ ràng

Ex: It soon became apparent to everyone that he couldn't sing.

half-measures

(noun). biện pháp nửa vời

Ex: There are no half measures with this company.

dispute

(noun). Xung đột, tranh cãi

Ex: The union is in dispute with management over working hours.

accurately

(adverb). một cách chính xác

Ex: The article accurately reflects public opinion.

legislation

(noun). Pháp luật

Ex: They are calling for tough legislation to tackle this problem.

equally

(adverb). bằng nhau

Ex: Diet and exercise are equally important.

valid

(adjective). có căn cứ

Ex: She had valid reasons for not supporting the proposals.

note

(verb). chú ý, nhận thấy

Ex: It should be noted that dissertations submitted late will not be accepted.

criticise

(verb). chỉ trích

Ex: The decision was harshly criticised by environmental groups.

society

(noun). xã hội

Ex: Every section of society must have access to education.

attack

(verb). tấn công, chỉ trích

Ex: He was publicly attacked for his political views.

propound

(verb). đề nghị, đề xuất, gợi ý

Ex: It was Ptolemy who propounded the theory that the earth was at the centre of the universe.

relation

(noun). mối quan hệ

Ex: Little of what he said has any relation to fact.

deviation

(noun). sự lệch, sự chệch hướng

Ex: We do not expect any significant deviations from the business plan.

avoid

(verb). tránh

Ex: We must find a way to avoid similar problems in future.

codify

(verb). hệ thống hóa

Ex: The authors wish to codify and clarify where privacy and free speech rights begin and end.

principle

(noun). Nguyên tắc

Ex: She went on to explain the principles behind what she was doing.

chaos

(noun). tình trạng hỗn loạn

Ex: Heavy snow has caused total chaos on the roads.

common

(adjective). chung, phổ biến

Ex:They share a common interest in photography.

record

(verb). ghi chép, ghi nhận

Ex: Unemployment is likely to reach the highest total that has ever been recorded.

alternative

(noun). lựa chọn khác

Ex: The car is too expensive so we're trying to find a cheaper alternative.

tenet

(noun). nguyên lý; giáo lý; chủ nghĩa

Ex: It is a tenet of contemporary psychology that an individual's mental health is supported by having good social networks.

analysis

(noun). phân tích

Ex: Further analysis revealed significant regional variations in the results.

blind

(adjective). mù quáng

Ex: blind anger/faith/prejudice Ex: It was a moment of blind panic.

radical

(adjective). triệt để, cực đoan

Ex: They described themselves as a radical feminists.

elitist

(adjective). thuộc nhóm ưu đẳng, thuộc nhóm tinh hoa

Ex: Universities are becoming far less elitist.

sections.title: Passage 2: Tidal Power
sections.html:
install

(verb). Lắp đặt

Ex: Make sure the equipment is properly installed.

site

(noun). địa điểm

Ex: People laid flowers at the site of the accident.

venture

(noun). dự án kinh doanh, việc mạo hiểm

Ex: She advised us to look abroad for more lucrative business ventures.

expect

(verb). mong đợi

Ex: They never expected to find their dream home.

turbine

(noun). tua bin

Ex: The flow of water drives the turbine, which is connected to an electrical generator to produce electricity.

cable

(noun). dây cáp

Ex: They're digging up the road to lay cables.

undersea

(adjective). dưới mặt biển, ngầm dưới biển; chìm

Ex: Britain and France are connected by an undersea tunnel.

via

(preposition). thông qua

Ex: The news programme came to us via satellite.

previous

(adjective). trước

Ex: No previous experience is necessary for this job.

attempt

(noun). lần thử, nỗ lực

Ex: Ex: Attempts are being made to resolve the problem of security in schools.

alternative

(adjective). khác

Ex: The road was closed so we had to find an alternative route.

export

(verb). Xuất khẩu

Ex: The islands export sugar and fruit.

originally

(adverb). khởi đầu, nguyên thủy

Ex: The school was originally very small.

abandon

(verb). từ bỏ, ruồng bỏ

Ex: By 1930 he had abandoned his Marxist principles.

reference

(noun). sự nói đến, sự nhắc đến

Ex: She made no reference to her illness but only to her future plans.

allow

(verb). Cho phép

Ex: This research must be allowed to continue.

major

(adjective). chủ yếu, quan trọng

Ex: He played a major role in setting up the system.

apply

(verb). áp dụng

Ex: New technology is being applied to almost every industrial process.

mention

(noun). sự nói đến, sự nhắc đến

Ex: He made no mention of her work.

possibility

(noun). khả năng, sự có thể

Ex: There is a real possibility of war.

tidal

(adjective). thuộc thuỷ triều, chịu ảnh hưởng của thuỷ triều

Ex: Several villages have been destroyed by a huge tidal wave.

claim

(noun). lời tuyên bố

Ex: The company had made false claims about its products.

input

(noun). đầu vào

Ex: The power input will come largely from hydroelectricity.

predictable

(adjective). có thể đoán trước được

Ex: The ending of the book was entirely predictable.

constant

(adjective). liên tục

Ex: There were constant interruptions.

reliable

(adjective). đáng tin cậy

Ex: Our information comes from a reliable source.

prospect

(noun). Triển vọng, khả năng

Ex: There's a reasonable prospect that his debts will be paid.

self-sufficient

(adjective). tự cung cấp, không phụ thuộc, độc lập

Ex: The country is totally self-sufficient in food production.

drastically

(adverb). quyết liệt

Ex: "We must learn to love our bodies," said the actress, shortly before having herself drastically remade by the cosmetic surgeon.

cut down on

(verb). giảm bớt

Ex: I'm trying to cut down on fatty foods.

emission

(noun). Sự thải

Ex: Bioluminescence is the emission of light from living organisms.

coal

(noun). than đá

Ex: She sat by the coal fire in the kitchen.

closure

(noun). sự đóng cửa

Ex: The village school has been saved from closure.

exist

(verb). Tồn tại

Ex: I don't think ghosts exist.

nuclear

(adjective). thuộc hạt nhân

Ex: China and India only produce a very small percentage of their electricity from nuclear facilities.

means

(noun). phương tiện

Ex: They had no means of communication

income

(noun). Thu nhập

Ex: Tourism is a major source of income for the area.

current

(noun). luồng (gió, không khí); dòng (nước, điện)

Ex: Switch off the electric current before changing the bulb.

vicinity

(noun). vùng phụ cận, vùng lân cận

Ex: There are several hotels in the immediate vicinity of the station.

coastline

(noun). đường bờ biển

Ex: Within a few years, the coastline was transformed in a 700 billion-lire tourist paradise.

resistance

(noun). sự chống cự, sự kháng lại

Ex: Resistance to change has nearly destroyed the industry.

fuel

(noun). nhiên liệu

Ex: Wood, coal, oil, petrol, and gas are all different kinds of fuel.

inland

(adjective). vùng nội địa

Ex: Business is booming in both inland and coastal resorts.

feature

(noun). đặc tính

Ex: Teamwork is a key feature of the training programme.

compensate

(verb). bù đắp

Ex: The company is planting trees to compensate for the greenhouse gas generated by airplane flights.

shortage

(noun). sự thiếu

Ex: There's a shortage of food and shelter in the refugee camps.

extraction

(noun). sự chiết, sự tách

Ex: The extraction of minerals has damaged the countryside.

maintenance

(noun). sự duy trì, sự bảo dưỡng

Ex: The school pays for heating and the maintenance of the buildings.

lift

(verb). nâng lên

Ex: The box was so heavy I could barely lift it.

creature

(noun). Sinh vật

Ex: Dogs are more social creatures than cats.

risk

(noun). rủi ro

Ex: The health risks are very low.

relatively

(adjective). vừa phải, tương đối

Ex: I found the test relatively easy.

comparatively

(adverb). tương đối

Ex: The unit is comparatively easy to install and cheap to operate.

receive

(verb). nhận được

Ex: We received a warm welcome from our hosts.

promptly

(adverb). nhanh chóng; ngay lập tức

Ex: He deals with all the correspondence promptly and efficiently.

pressure

(noun). áp lực

Ex: The nurse applied pressure to his arm to stop the bleeding.

respond

(verb). phản hồi

Ex: She never responded to my letter.

technical

(adjective). thuộc mảng kỹ thuật

Ex: We offer free technical support for those buying our software.

extent

(noun). Mức độ

Ex: To a certain extent, we are all responsible for this tragic situation.

impact

(noun). tác động

Ex: Her speech made a profound impact on everyone.

significant

(adjective). Đáng lưu ý, quan trọng

Ex: There are no significant differences between the two groups of students.

operate

(verb). Vận hành

Ex: Solar panels can only operate in sunlight.

identify

(verb). Xác định, nhận dạng

Ex: They are trying to identify what is wrong with the present system.

sustainable

(adjective). Có thể duy trì lâu dài; Thân thiện với môi trường

Ex: This type of farming is simply not sustainable any more.

advanced

(adjective). hiện đại, nâng cao

Ex: Sweden has a reputation for advanced and stylish design.

jointly

(adverb). cùng, cùng nhau

Ex: The event was organized jointly by students and staff.

fund

(verb). tài trợ

Ex: Who is funding this research?

department

(noun). cục; sở; ty; ban; khoa

Ex: He is a lecturer in the department of psychology at Trinity College, Dublin.

charge

(noun). nhiệm vụ, bổn phận, trách nhiệm

Ex: He asked to speak to the person in charge.

deal with

(verb). giải quyết

Ex: Not all complaints are so easily dealt with.

vibration

(noun). sự rung động, sự chuyển động

Ex: We could feel the vibrations from the trucks passing outside.

hostile

(adjective). (môi trường) không thân thiện, khắc nghiệt

Ex: I was concerned because everyone I asked said that it was a really hostile environment to grow produce.

commercial

(adjective). mang tính thương mại

Ex: She is developing the commercial side of the organization.

marine

(adjective). thuộc về biển

Ex: The oil slick seriously threatens marine life around the islands.

generator

(noun). Máy phát

Ex: Tourism is Australia's greatest generator of employment.

slight

(adjective). nhẹ

Ex: There's been a slight delay, but we'll be landing in just a few minutes.

diameter

(noun). đường kính

Ex: The diameter of the tree trunk was more than a metre.

require

(verb). cần, yêu cầu

Ex: These pets require a lot of care and attention.

objection

(noun). sự phản đối, sự chống đối

Ex: I have no objection to staying here.

mount

(verb). cắm vào, dựng lên, đặt

Ex: Cameras are mounted around the city.

supply

(noun). nguồn cung cấp

Ex: Advances in agriculture increased the food supply.

grid

(noun). mạng lưới điện

Ex: Power can be fed from wind generators into the electricity grid system.

warn

(verb). cảnh báo

Ex: Security experts warned about the problems months ago.

damage

(noun). tổn hại

Ex: The fire has caused severe damage to the building.

avoid

(verb). tránh

Ex: We must find a way to avoid similar problems in future.

concern

(noun). mối lo ngại, mối quan tâm

Ex: Villagers expressed concern about the level of traffic.

submerge

(verb). nhấn chìm

Ex: The fields had been submerged by floodwater.

debris

(noun). Mảnh vỡ

Ex: Emergency teams are still clearing the debris from the plane crash.

robust

(adjective). Mạnh mẽ

Ex: She was almost 90, but still very robust.

sections.title: Passage 3: Information theory - the big idea
sections.html:
affect

(verb). ảnh hưởng

Ex: Your opinion will not affect my decision.

transmission

(noun). sự truyền tín hiệu

Ex: We apologize for the interruption to our transmissions this afternoon.

remain

(verb). vẫn, giữ như cũ

Ex: Train fares are likely to remain unchanged.

explanation

(noun). giải thích

Ex: The most likely explanation is that his plane was delayed.

factor

(noun). Nhân tố

Ex: The result will depend on a number of different factors.

rate

(noun). Tốc độ

Ex: Most people walk at an average rate of five kilometres an hour.

limit

(noun). Giới hạn

Ex: There is a limit to the amount of pain we can bear.

omit

(verb). bỏ qua; lược bỏ

Ex: Please don’t omit any details, no matter how minor they may seem.

foundation

(noun). nền tảng

Ex: Respect and friendship provide a solid foundation for marriage.

efficient

(adjective). Hiệu quả

Ex: We offer a fast, friendly and efficient service.

store

(verb). lưu trữ, cất giữ

Ex: We are conducting research into how information is stored in the brain.

strip

(verb). lột bỏ

Ex: We had to strip out all the old wiring and start again.

contribute

(verb). đóng góp

Ex: We contributed £5 000 to the earthquake fund.

redundant

(adjective). dư thừa

Ex: There's a lot of redundant information that you could cut out here.

unnecessary

(adjective). không cần thiết

Ex: Don't take any unnecessary risks.

reference

(noun). sự nói đến, sự nhắc đến

Ex: She made no reference to her illness but only to her future plans.

theory

(noun). Giả thuyết; học thuyết

Ex: He has a theory that the hole was caused by a meteorite.

capable

(adjective). Có thể, có khả năng

Ex: You are capable of better work than this.

attitude

(noun). Thái độ

Ex: If you want to pass your exams you'd better change your attitude!

fame

(noun). tiếng tăm, danh tiếng, tên tuổi

Ex: She went to Hollywood in search of fame and fortune.

shun

(verb). tránh, xa lánh, lảng xa

Ex: They were both shunned by their families when they remarried.

acclaim

(noun). sự tán dương

Ex: His discoveries earned him wide acclaim.

interpret

(verb). Diễn giải, hiểu

Ex: The data can be interpreted in many different ways.

detect

(verb). Dò tìm, phát hiện

Ex: The tests are designed to detect the disease early.

ensure

(verb). Đảm bảo

Ex: We are working to ensure the safety of people in the city.

account

(noun). Lời tường thuật

Ex: The diaries contained a detailed account of the writer's experiences in China.

incident

(noun). Sự việc

Ex: He came to regret the whole incident.

demonstrate

(verb). Trình bày, minh hoạ

Ex: New research convincingly demonstrates that age-related memory loss is not inevitable.

application

(noun). ứng dụng

Ex: The design has many applications.

involve

(verb). liên quan, bao hàm

Ex: The test will involve answering questions about a photograph.

initially

(adverb). lúc đầu

Ex: Initially, the system worked well.

intend

(verb). Dự định

Ex: The train we had intended to catch had already left.

achieve

(verb). Đạt được, giành được

Ex: He had finally achieved success.

set out

(verb). bắt đầu

Ex: They succeeded in what they set out to do.

apparently

(adverb). rõ ràng

Ex: I thought she had retired, but apparently she hasn't.

pin down

(verb). xác định

Ex: The cause of the disease is difficult to pin down precisely.

aim

(noun). mục đích, mục tiêu

Ex: Our main aim is to provide affordable childcare.

precise

(adjective). Chính xác

Ex: Can you give a more precise definition of the word?

concept

(noun). khái niệm, ý tưởng

Ex: Students must be able to apply classroom concepts to practical situations.

probe

(noun). máy thăm dò

Ex: It was the first space probe to provide detailed images of the two largest planets and their major moons.

transmit

(verb). truyền

Ex: The disease cannot be transmitted through coughing or sneezing.

spectacular

(adjective). Ngoạn mục

Ex: It was a spectacular achievement on their part.

soar

(verb). bay cao

Ex: The rocket soared up into the air.

launch

(verb). phóng (tên lửa, vệ tinh,...)

Ex: The satellite was successfully launched into orbit earlier this month.

fear

(verb). sợ, lo ngại, e ngại

Ex: It was feared that unemployment could rise.

sensor

(noun). Thiết bị cảm biến

Ex: The security device has a heat sensor which detects the presence of people and animals.

circuit

(noun). mạch điện

Ex: A defect was found in the electrical circuit.

on the brink of

(adverb). trên bờ vực (một điều gì đó sắp xảy ra)

Ex: Scientists are on the brink of making a major new discovery.

replace

(verb). thay thế

Ex: The new design will eventually replace all existing models.

solution

(noun). Giải pháp

Ex: Attempts to find a solution have failed.

spare

(noun). đồ dự phòng

Ex: If you forget the key, Mrs Jones over the road has a spare.

depth

(noun). độ sâu

Ex: What's the depth of the water here?

means

(noun). phương tiện

Ex: They had no means of communication

belong

(verb). Thuộc về, của

Ex: The islands belong to Spain.

attempt

(noun). lần thử, nỗ lực

Ex: Ex: Attempts are being made to resolve the problem of security in schools.

fundamental

(adjective). Căn bản, cốt lõi

Ex: You have a fundamental right to privacy.

define

(verb). Định nghĩa

Ex: The term ‘mental illness’ is difficult to define.

set about

(verb). bắt đầu

Ex: We need to set about finding a solution.

otherwise

(adverb). nếu không thì

Ex: My parents lent me the money. Otherwise, I couldn't have afforded the trip.

vague

(adjective). Mơ hồ

Ex: She rolled her eyes at the vague response.

identify

(verb). Xác định, nhận dạng

Ex: They are trying to identify what is wrong with the present system.

relative

(adjective). cân xứng với, cân đối với, tuỳ theo

Ex: We need to assess the relative importance of each of these factors.

determine

(verb). Quyết định

Ex: Upbringing plays an important part in determining a person's character.

capacity

(noun). khả năng

Ex: She has an enormous capacity for hard work.

convey

(verb). truyền tải

Ex: Colours like red convey a sense of energy and strength.

major

(adjective). chủ yếu, quan trọng

Ex: He played a major role in setting up the system.

anticipate

(verb). Dự đoán

Ex: We anticipate that sales will rise next year.

breakthrough

(noun). Bước đột phá

Ex: Scientists are hoping for a breakthrough in the search for a cure for cancer.

ultimate

(adjective). cuối cùng

Ex: We will accept ultimate responsibility for whatever happens.

discover

(verb). Khám phá

Ex: She recently discovered two fungi that were new to science.

so-called

(adjective). Được gọi là

Ex: How have these so-called improvements helped the local community?

lie

(verb). nằm ở

Ex: The answer seems to lie elsewhere.

exposure

(noun). sự tiếp xúc

Ex: You should always limit your exposure to the sun.

manage

(verb). cố gắng xoay xở, thành công trong việc làm gì đó khó

Ex: We managed to get to the airport in time.

astonishing

(adjective). gây kinh ngạc

Ex: I find it absolutely astonishing that you didn't like it.

single-handedly

(adverb). tự mình

Ex: She brought up three children single-handedly.

genuine

(adjective). thật

Ex: She always showed genuine concern for others.

crucial

(adjective). Tối quan trọng

Ex: Parents play a crucial role in preparing their child for school.

feat

(noun). chiến tích

Ex: They have pulled off an extraordinary feat in completing the voyage.

ambiguous

(adjective). mơ hồ, nhập nhằng

Ex: Her account was deliberately ambiguous.

genetic

(adjective). thuộc về gen, di truyền

Ex: This is a form of genetic modification.

central

(adjective). quan trọng nhất

Ex: Prevention also plays a central role in traditional medicine.

enable

(verb). Cho phép

Ex: This new programme will enable older people to study at college.

freezing

(adjective). giá lạnh, băng giá, rét mướt

Ex: It's freezing in here!

temperature

(noun). Nhiệt độ

Ex: The climate is generally mild, and freezing temperatures are almost unknown.

expert

(noun). Chuyên gia

Ex: According to our panel of leading industry experts, a downturn is inevitable.

instruct

(verb). chỉ dẫn

Ex: You will be instructed where to go as soon as the plane is ready.

orbit

(noun). Quỹ đạo

Ex: A new satellite has been put into orbit around the earth.

incredibly

(adverb). đáng kinh ngạc, đến không ngờ

Ex: It was all incredibly difficult.

faint

(adjective). mờ, không rõ

Ex: We saw the faint outline of the mountain through the mist.

triumph

(noun). chiến thắng

Ex: It was a personal triumph over her old rival.

highlight

(verb). nhấn mạnh

Ex: This study highlights the fact that couples are keen to assist others.

technique

(noun). Kĩ thuật

Ex: Researchers used advanced techniques to analyse the brain scans.

gadget

(noun). Đồ dùng, đồ vật

Ex: We live in a world filled with high-tech gadgets.

entire

(adjective). toàn bộ

Ex: You two are her favourite people in the entire world.

inveigle

(verb). lấy được, dụ dỗ

Ex: Her son tried to inveigle her into giving him the money for a car.

satellite

(noun). vệ tinh nhân tạo

Ex: The World Cup was transmitted around the world by satellite.

rapidly

(adverb). 1 cách nhanh chóng

Ex: Crime figures are rising rapidly.

accurately

(adverb). một cách chính xác

Ex: The article accurately reflects public opinion.

down-to-earth

(adjective). thực tế, không viễn vông

Ex: Fran's a very friendly, down-to-earth person.

originally

(adverb). khởi đầu, nguyên thủy

Ex: The school was originally very small.

prestigious

(adjective). Danh giá

Ex: My parents wanted me to go to a more prestigious university.

institute

(noun). viện

Ex: The report was compiled by Germany's five leading economic research institutes

capture

(verb). bắt lấy, lưu giữ lại

Ex: The attack was captured on film by security cameras.

process

(noun). quá trình

Ex: It's a normal part of the learning process.

guarantee

(verb). cam kết, đảm bảo

Ex: Basic human rights, including freedom of speech, are now guaranteed.

random

(adjective). Ngẫu nghiên

Ex: He grabbed a random pair of jeans and an old red shirt.

interference

(noun). sự can thiệp, sự xen vào, sự gây trở ngại

Ex: She seems to regard any advice or help from me as interference.

intact

(adjective). còn nguyên vẹn, không bị ảnh hưởng

Ex: Most of the house remains intact even after two hundred years.

generalise

(verb). nói chung chung

Ex: It would be foolish to generalise from a single example.

via

(preposition). thông qua

Ex: The news programme came to us via satellite.

cope with

(verb). giải quyết

Ex: It must be really hard to cope with three young children and a job.

ravages

(noun). sự phá hoại

Ex: Her looks had not survived the ravages of time.

devise

(verb). nghĩ ra, sáng chế

Ex: A new system has been devised to control traffic in the city.

method

(noun). Phương pháp

Ex: Which method is the most effective?

prove

(verb). Chứng minh

Ex: She was determined to prove everyone wrong.

stunningly

(adverb). gây ấn tượng sâu sắc, gây ngạc nhiên, làm choáng váng

Ex: The countryside around here is stunningly beautiful.

key

(adjective). chủ chốt

Ex: He was a key figure in the campaign.

revolution

(noun). cuộc cách mạng

Ex: A revolution in information technology is taking place.

calculate

(verb). Tính, tính toán

Ex: We haven’t really calculated the cost of the vacation yet.

cram

(verb). nhồi, nhét, tống vào

Ex: He crammed eight people into his car.
